dimensions.assessment: Affects federal financial regulatory agencies and supervised banking and financial institutions.
dimensions.evidence: require the Federal financial institutions regulatory agencies to update the CAMELS Rating System

dimensions.assessment: Changes how financial institutions are evaluated for safety, soundness, mergers, and deposit insurance premiums.
dimensions.evidence: basis for determining significant regulatory matters such as the evaluation for mergers and acquisitions and a bank's deposit insurance premiums

dimensions.assessment: No federal spending or revenue implications are stated in the source text.
Mandates specific multi-agency rulemakings, public comment periods, and statutory adjustments to the Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council Act and Bank Holding Company Act.
dimensions.evidence: The Council shall make recommendations to amend the Uniform Financial Institutions Rating System

dimensions.assessment: Permanent updates to federal bank supervision and rating systems.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 12 months after the Council makes the recommendations... the Federal financial institutions regulatory agencies shall, jointly, issue rules

missing_information: Specific administrative costs for implementing the new rating system rulemakings
importance_detail.rationale: The HUMPS Act of 2025 directs federal financial regulatory agencies to update the CAMELS rating system by establishing clear and objective criteria, revising or eliminating the management component, and ensuring ratings incorporate anti-money laundering compliance.
